uutiset.t: Taiwan Mulls Lowering Margin Requirement to Support Stock Market
uutiset.s: Taiwan is considering lowering the margin requirement ratio for stock investors using borrowed funds as it tries to stem a selloff after the benchmark equity index’s worst week in 35 years.

uutiset.t: US Power Advantage Over China Shrinks Further on Iran War Effect
uutiset.s: The advantage the US has over China in influencing the course of international events has shrunk to the smallest level since 2018, with the Iran war and unilateralism undermining its military and diplomatic strength, according to a new report.

uutiset.t: Asia’s Stock Rescue Efforts Gather Pace After Wall Street Plunge
uutiset.s: Asian authorities are stepping up efforts to stem a deepening stock-market rout, with China easing margin requirements, and Taiwan and South Korea rolling out intervention measures following Friday’s plunge in US equities.

uutiset.t: From Squeezes to Meltdown, a Week of Mayhem Rocks Metals Markets
uutiset.s: As the copper industry gathered in Shanghai last week, Grace Li was struck by the overwhelmingly bearish mood over the outlook for demand. She agreed with the pessimism. In fact, she came close to pulling out her phone on the spot to put on a short position after her Monday conversations.

uutiset.t: S. Korea Rolls Out Phased Measures to Stabilize Stock Market
uutiset.s: South Korea announced phased measures to calm markets amid rising volatility, including ensuring a stock stabilization fund is in place to respond when needed, top financial officials said after an emergency meeting on Sunday.

uutiset.t: UBS Capital Fight Enters Final Round as Lawmakers Resume Debate
uutiset.s: The argument over UBS Group AG’s future capital requirements is headed for a showdown, with the odds tilted toward defeat for the global wealth manager.

uutiset.t: China’s $1.7 Trillion AI Rout Turns Hot Trade Into Losing Bet
